about_page.origin_text: The association was born from the initiative of a group of board game and RPG enthusiasts living in Terrassa, who had been organizing informal meetups in the area for some time. With the desire to have a stable structure, their own space, and the ability to organize events independently, they decided to formalize the project. After a process of deliberation and administrative procedures, the association was officially founded on September 14, 2024.
about_page.mission_text: Create a meeting space for board game and RPG players from Terrassa and surroundings, promoting alternative leisure in an inclusive, friendly, and Catalan-speaking environment.
about_page.vision_text: Become a local reference and be recognized by publishers and distributors as an active and reliable association for demonstrations, events, and collaborations.

conduct.title: Code of conduct
conduct.intro: This document contains what we consider proper behaviour and is what we expect from those who wish to participate or get involved in DarkStone Catalunya's activities, including players, game masters, and administrators.
conduct.safe_space_text: We consider diversity on equal footing an essential good, therefore discriminatory attitudes are not acceptable for any reason, including but not limited to discrimination based on gender, sexual orientation, identity, or origin.
conduct.safe_space_harassment: Harassment and the use of threats have no place in this space, and we ask that if you suffer or witness them, you contact the administrators to prevent it.
conduct.safe_space_safety: To ensure this, we ask people who run games to use safety measures such as the X card, the traffic light system, or lines and veils, as well as any other measure that allows the smooth running of games.
conduct.safe_space_protocol: In case of harassment or any other type of abuse, follow the DarkStone Catalunya <link>Anti-Harassment Protocol</link>.
conduct.catalan_text: One of our organization's objectives is to promote the use of Catalan in leisure spaces and games and during organized play. For this reason, we ask for your involvement and to promote its use as the priority language whenever possible. Not knowing the language is in no case an impediment to participating in games or being part of the group, but we ask for a positive and generous attitude in this regard. We are sure that together we will do everything possible to understand each other and help improve language skills if necessary!
conduct.communication_title: Space for understanding and respectful communication
conduct.communication_respectful: Be respectful, considerate, and constructive: Disagreement, which happens often, is not an excuse for rudeness or personal attacks. When responding, offer alternatives instead of negatives. Remember that a community where people feel uncomfortable cannot be fun, a key issue for achieving our main goal: having a great time playing.
conduct.communication_patient: Be patient and generous: If someone asks for help, it's because they need it. Offer kind responses that can help the person asking without resorting to aggressive replies or the «read the manual» style.
conduct.communication_understand: Make an effort to correctly understand what people mean: Remember that decisions are often a difficult choice between opposing poles. If you disagree, please express yourself courteously. If something seems outrageous, check that you haven't misinterpreted it. When in doubt, ask for clarification, but don't assume the most negative interpretation.
conduct.communication_concise: Try to be concise: Avoid repeating what has already been said. Unnecessarily prolonging conversations makes them hard to follow. People may feel personally offended when receiving many messages that repeat the same thing.
conduct.communication_topics: Respect the topics and copyrights: Do not send messages with topics unrelated to the scope of the communication space you are addressing. For example, commercial messages, or political or religious content. On the other hand, we ask that you do not share copyrighted material on the channel.
conduct.collaboration_text: Collaboration is fundamental in community-based projects. We encourage you to work together whether within or outside your own projects, seeking synergies. Collaboration reduces redundant efforts and improves the quality of our work. Internally and externally, we must always be open to collaboration.
conduct.open_tables_text: DarkStone Catalunya is an open social space where we want to encourage neighbourhood and collective participation. For this reason, we ask that proposed activities be, whenever possible, open to new participants. The DarkStone Catalunya coordination team will ensure that there is always at least one open table so that anyone interested who requests it with enough notice can play with us as far as possible. Furthermore, we encourage established gaming groups to periodically rotate or open spots.

collaborators.title: Our Partners
collaborators.subtitle: Thanks to those who make this adventure possible
collaborators.editorial_invite: Are you a publisher or shop and want to collaborate with us? We organize demos, game days, and events. You can reach us through our <contactLink>contact form</contactLink> or write to us directly at <emailLink>hola@darkstone.cat</emailLink>.

descriptions.ajuntament-terrassa: Terrassa City Council supports the city's cultural and gaming organisations, providing spaces and resources for our activities.
descriptions.diputacio-barcelona: The Barcelona Provincial Council promotes the associative network of the province, collaborating with organisations like Darkstone Catalunya.
descriptions.devir: Founded in 1987, Devir is the largest publisher of modern games in Spanish, Portuguese, and Catalan. They brought classics like Catan and Carcassonne to these markets and created acclaimed original titles such as White Castle and Bitoku.
descriptions.maldito-games: Spanish publisher founded in 2015, specialising in bringing top titles like Brass Birmingham, Terraforming Mars, and Barcelona to the Spanish-speaking market. Over 300 games in their catalogue, with attention to detail as their hallmark.
descriptions.2-tomatoes: Publisher founded in 2016, combining world-renowned licences like Root, Pax Pamir, and Magic Maze with original creations. They champion games as educational tools and actively collaborate with content creators and associations.
descriptions.dmz: A young publisher backing homegrown designers alongside hand-picked international titles like Urban Sketchers, Harmony, and Lorenzo il Magnifico. Quality in design, components, and artwork above all else.
descriptions.draco-ideas: Draco Ideas is a Spanish publisher that stands out for its thematic games and attention to detail in every production.
descriptions.eclipse: Spanish publisher founded in 2017, championing homegrown talent. Creators of Skull Tales and Tambores de Guerra, with an adventure-filled catalogue for all audiences. Linked to Draco Ideas.
descriptions.games-4-gamers: Barcelona-based publisher founded in 2014 by two neighbourhood friends with one clear idea: games are culture, education, and fun. They make board games for all players.
descriptions.juegorama: Publisher and miniatures manufacturer from Zaragoza, founded in 2014. Passionate about detail, they've brought titles like Massive Darkness 2 and GI JOE Deck Building Game while crafting high-quality miniatures.
descriptions.key-enigma: A team dedicated to crafting escape adventures that blend puzzles, narrative, and technology. Their boxes blur the line between reality and fiction with real websites, phone calls, and emails.
descriptions.synergic-games: Publisher founded to launch Harakiri: Blades of Honor, a cooperative dungeon-crawler set in feudal Japan. Stunning art from renowned illustrators and sculpted miniatures for total immersion.
descriptions.sd-games: SD Games is a publisher founded in 2015 with the goal of bringing modern board games to a wider audience while building a catalogue that also appeals to experienced gamers. A division of SD Distribuciones, Spain's leading specialist distributor with 25 years of experience, they are committed to championing Spanish designers and illustrators, giving visibility to homegrown talent of outstanding quality.
descriptions.tranjis-games: Three geeks, one crazy idea in 2014, and Virus! was born — the best-selling Spanish card game ever with over 3 million copies sold. Today they're a leading publisher with titles like It's a Wonderful World.
descriptions.trencadaus: TrencaDaus is the brainchild of Jordi and Susana, two game lovers who left the film industry to create unforgettable tabletop experiences. Design, creativity, and passion in every game.
descriptions.ak-interactive: A leading Spanish brand in scale modelling, specialising in paints, tools, and products for models and dioramas. We hosted the presentation of their PLAYMARKERS, a marker system for organising scale model parts, designed for modellers of all levels.
descriptions.awaken-realms: Polish publisher behind crowdfunding hits such as Nemesis, Tainted Grail, and ISS Vanguard. Born as a miniature painting studio, they stand out for their spectacular figures and deep game designs. We collaborated with them to host the official Castles of Burgundy tournament, with their stunning miniature edition as the prize.
descriptions.mel-negra: A Catalan publisher committed to releasing tabletop RPGs and board games in Catalan. They translate titles from the English-speaking world and produce material with local talent, always using FSC-certified paper and Catalan suppliers. We joined the presentation and play session of their RPG Misèries i malaurances.
descriptions.nosolorol: A Madrid-based publisher with over fifteen years of experience specialising in tabletop RPGs. Their catalogue includes classics like Aquelarre, Vampire: The Masquerade, and Dune, as well as internationally licensed in-house productions. They provided us with material to showcase and demo some of their games at Egara Juga.
descriptions.looping-games: A Spanish publisher born in 2013 from the union of Perepau Llistosella's mechanical finesse and Pedro Soto's artistic expressiveness. They publish great 20th-century stories inside small boxes, with acclaimed titles such as «1911 Amundsen vs Scott», «Topoum», and the 1900 series. Passionate about design, narrative, and the craft of turning hand-drawn prototypes into successful published games.
descriptions.outlet-games: Online shop specialising in board games at great prices. They maintain a close bond with Darkstone Catalunya and the gaming community.
descriptions.nikochan: Shop specialising in comics, merchandise, books, board games, and TCGs. They host Digimon, One Piece, and other tournaments. We've collaborated to organise open gaming sessions at their shop.
descriptions.kame-kame-comics: A go-to geek shop in Catalonia with 5 retail locations, specialising in manga, comics, figures, board games, and wargames. A paradise for anyone who lives pop culture with passion.
descriptions.el-carton-peleon: Shop specialising in TCGs with daily tournaments across multiple games. Also passionate about board games, they host planned gaming sessions and have a small open game library for everyone.
descriptions.stastarat: A veteran Terrassa association with nearly 40 years of history and around 80 members. RPGs, board games, wargames, and video games. They have their own venue and host 12-hour gaming days every month.
descriptions.la-torre-de-daus: La Torre de Daus is a non-profit cultural association from Sabadell, with a 220m²+ venue equipped with gaming tables, scenography, a game library, painting workshop and bar. Specialising in wargames, miniatures, historical simulation and board games, members enjoy 24h access with their own key.
descriptions.tastajocs: A gaming cultural association from Castellar del Vallès with 52 members, founded in 2019 as a regular group and officially established as an association in 2025. Specialising in modern board games and RPGs, they meet every Friday and Saturday at their venue with two gaming rooms.
descriptions.darkstone-es: Darkstone is a leading online community and forum in Spain dedicated to board games and crowdfunding. A meeting point for enthusiasts looking for news, discussions, buying and selling, and event organisation around geek culture and board games.
descriptions.la-marca-degara: A non-profit association from Terrassa, founded in 2013 in the Les Fonts neighbourhood and devoted to wargames, RPGs, strategy games, and scale modelling. They run open play sessions, tournaments such as Warhammer's Marquès d'Ègara, and miniature painting workshops. They are founding members of the Federació Catalana de Wargames and drive Egara Juga! together with Darkstone Catalunya.
descriptions.professor-mompi: Our go-to game educator. A channel dedicated to board game tutorials in Catalan, especially expert-level games. A key reference for the Catalan-speaking gaming community.
descriptions.jugador-inicial: A board game outreach portal in Catalan created by Àlex in 2020. Tutorials, recommendations and the latest releases for anyone who loves board games. A project that keeps growing thanks to its community.
descriptions.cunyadisme-ludic: The gaming podcast nobody asked for but you need to hear. Hosted by Adrià alongside Karen, Alberto and Àlex, it was born from a group of friends brought together by board games who ended up talking about everything. Humour, friendship and board games in Catalan.
descriptions.barbut-indepe: A Darkstone Catalunya member, die-hard eurogamer who hates dice and advocate for the use of Catalan in the board gaming world. On his Instagram he reviews and analyses the games he plays.

cookie_policy.title: Cookie policy
cookie_policy.intro: This page explains what cookies are, which ones we use on this website and how you can manage them.
cookie_policy.what_text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They are used to remember preferences, analyse traffic and improve the browsing experience.
cookie_policy.cookies_necessary: Technical cookies: Essential for the website to function. These include the consent preference cookie that remembers your choice regarding analytical cookies.
cookie_policy.cookies_analytics: Analytical cookies: Only activated if you accept their use. We use Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_* cookies) for anonymous visit statistics, and Vercel Analytics for performance metrics.
cookie_policy.third_party_google: Google Analytics: Google may process collected data according to its privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).
cookie_policy.third_party_vercel: Vercel Analytics: Vercel processes web performance metrics (vercel.com/docs/analytics).
cookie_policy.manage_text: You can accept or reject analytical cookies via the banner that appears the first time you visit the website. You can also configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Please note that blocking all cookies may affect the functionality of some features.
cookie_policy.updates_text: This cookie policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in the cookies used or applicable regulations.

data_protection.title: Data protection policy
data_protection.user_info_p1: Associació DarkStone Catalunya, as Data Controller, informs you that, in accordance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, of 27 April, (GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018, of 5 December, on the protection of personal data and guarantee of digital rights (LOPDGDD), we will process your data as set out in this Privacy Policy.
data_protection.user_info_p2: In this Privacy Policy we describe how we collect your personal data and why we collect it, what we do with it, who we share it with, how we protect it and your options regarding the processing of your personal data.
data_protection.user_info_p3: This Policy applies to the processing of your personal data collected by Associació DarkStone Catalunya for the provision of its services. If you accept the measures of this Policy, you accept that we process your personal data as defined in this Policy.
data_protection.contact_name: Legal name: Associació de Jugadors i Jugadores de jocs de taula i rol DarkStone Catalunya
data_protection.principles_intro: We have always been committed to providing our services with the highest degree of quality, which includes treating your data with security and transparency. Our principles are:
data_protection.principles_legality: Legality: We will only collect your personal data for specific, explicit and legitimate purposes.
data_protection.principles_minimization: Data minimisation: We limit the collection of personal data to what is strictly relevant and necessary for the purposes for which it has been collected.
data_protection.principles_purpose: Purpose limitation: We will only collect your personal data for the stated purposes and only according to your wishes.
data_protection.principles_security: Data security: We apply appropriate and proportionate technical and organisational measures to the risks to ensure that your data does not suffer damage, such as unauthorised disclosure or access, accidental or unlawful destruction or accidental loss or alteration and any other form of unlawful processing.
data_protection.principles_access: Access and Rectification: We have the means for you to access or rectify data when you deem appropriate.
data_protection.principles_retention: Retention: We retain your personal data lawfully and appropriately and only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.
data_protection.principles_marketing: Direct Marketing and cookies: We comply with applicable advertising and cookie legislation.
data_protection.data_collection_title: 4. Collection and processing of your personal data
data_protection.data_collection_p1: The types of data that may be requested and processed are: identifying data.
data_protection.data_collection_p2: Whenever we request your personal data, we will clearly inform you of what personal data we collect and for what purpose. In general, we collect and process your personal data for the purpose of providing information.
data_protection.legitimacy_p1: In accordance with applicable data protection regulations, your personal data may be processed provided that:
data_protection.legitimacy_consent: You have given us consent for the purposes of the processing. Of course, you may withdraw your consent at any time.
data_protection.data_sharing_text: Associació DarkStone Catalunya will not transfer your data to any third party, except by legal obligation.
data_protection.rights_intro: In relation to the collection and processing of your personal data, you may contact us at any time to:
data_protection.rights_access: Access your personal data and any other information indicated in Article 15.1 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_rectification: Rectify personal data that is inaccurate or incomplete in accordance with Article 16 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_erasure: Erase your personal data in accordance with Article 17 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_restriction: Restrict the processing of your personal data in accordance with Article 18 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_portability: Request the portability of your data in accordance with Article 20 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_objection: Object to the processing of your personal data in accordance with Article 21 of the GDPR.
data_protection.rights_withdrawal: If you have given your consent for a specific purpose, you have the right to withdraw the consent given at any time, without this affecting the lawfulness of the processing based on the consent prior to its withdrawal.
data_protection.rights_exercise: You may exercise these rights by sending a reasoned and accredited communication to darkstone.cat@gmail.com
data_protection.rights_complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory Authority (www.aepd.es) if you consider that the processing does not comply with current regulations.
data_protection.legal_info_p1: The requirements of this Policy complement, and do not replace, any other existing requirement under applicable data protection law, which shall prevail in any case.
data_protection.legal_info_p2: This Policy is subject to periodic reviews and Associació DarkStone Catalunya may modify it at any time. When this happens, we will notify you of any changes and ask you to re-read the most recent version of our Policy and confirm your acceptance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Darkstone Catalunya
faq.what_is_a: We are a non-profit association dedicated to board games and role-playing games in Terrassa. We meet every week to play, share the hobby and promote the Catalan language in the gaming community.
faq.cost_a: Membership is completely free! There are no fees or payments. With your registration you get access to all sessions and the association's game library with over 100 games.
faq.bring_games_q: Do I need to bring my own games?
faq.bring_games_a: Not at all! The association has a game library with over 100 board games you can browse on our website. If you want to bring your own games, you're welcome to!
faq.age_a: Everyone is welcome! Minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult. We have games for all ages and experience levels.
faq.location_a: We meet at Centre Cívic Ca N'Aurell, Plaça del Tint, 4 in Terrassa (08224). The space is accessible and well connected by public transport.
faq.schedule_a: We are open every Friday from {fridayOpens} to {fridayCloses} and every Saturday from {saturdayOpens} to {saturdayCloses}. You can come whenever you like during these hours — no booking or notice required.
faq.non_member_q: Can I come without being a member?
faq.non_member_a: Yes! You don't need to be a member to come and play — everyone is welcome at any session. Becoming a member is not mandatory, but it helps us a lot to keep the association and activities running.
faq.game_types_q: What types of games do you have?
faq.game_types_a: We have all kinds of board games: strategy, cooperative, family, party games, wargames, eurogames, ameritrash and much more. You can browse the full catalogue in our online game library.
faq.rpg_q: Do you run role-playing game sessions?
faq.rpg_a: Yes! We organise role-playing game sessions regularly. If you want to run or join a game, talk to us and we'll coordinate schedules and tables.
faq.join_q: How can I become a member?
faq.join_a: Come to any session and talk to us, or contact us through the contact form on the website. The process is quick and simple: just fill in a registration form. It's free!

procedures.intro: What to do when a request reaches the board outside the website.

p1.title: Reinstating a former member
p1.s1: Find the person in Members with the "Former members" filter (name, member number or e-mail). If they are not there, their record was purged (more than 3 years since the baixa): tell them to sign up again as a new member.
p1.s2: Confirm identity. The request must come from the e-mail of the account. If it came from another address or in person, write to the account e-mail and wait for the answer.
p1.s3: Read the last baixa in the member's file. If the board gave it, discuss the request with the board before accepting it.
p1.s4: Look for duplicates. If the person signed up again with another account, ask which one to keep. Then give the other one a baixa with the reason "Duplicate account".
p1.s5: Click "Reinstate" and record how the request arrived.
p1.s6: The member receives the e-mail automatically. Reply to the request too: the old card no longer works, the new one is in "Card", and the newsletter is off until they switch it on.

p2.title: Removing a member by board decision
p2.s1: Check that the decision follows the statutes and has been agreed by the board.
p2.s2: Before deciding, inform the member of the facts and give them the chance to explain themselves.
p2.s3: If the member holds a board role, a superadmin removes it first.
p2.s4: Click "Remove member" with a reason the member can read. They receive it by e-mail.

p3.title: Data access request
p3.s1: Confirm identity through the account e-mail.
p3.s2: Click "Export data" in the member's file.
p3.s3: Send the file to the account e-mail within one month of the request.

p4.title: Data erasure request
p4.s1: Confirm identity through the account e-mail.
p4.s2: If the person is still an active member, give the baixa first, with the reason "Erasure request".
p4.s4: Reply within one month. Explain that name, DNI and dates stay blocked until the purge date because of possible liabilities, and give that date.

p5.title: Lost or shared card
p5.s1: Click "Regenerate card". The old QR stops working at once.
p5.s2: Tell the member to download the new card from "Card".

p6.title: A member cannot sign in
p6.s1_a: If they are not listed, the account was never confirmed and was deleted, or it never existed. Tell them to sign up again.
p6.s1_b: If they are a former member, follow <p1>P-1</p1> instead.
p6.s2: Click "Send access link". The link goes only to the account e-mail.
p6.s3: Tell them to check the spam folder. Once inside, they can set a new password from "Account".
p6.s4: If they no longer have access to that e-mail, the board cannot change it. The person signs up again with the new e-mail, and the board gives the old account a baixa with the reason "Duplicate account".

p7.title: Sending an e-mail to the members
p7.s1: Choose the list by the purpose of the message:
p7.s1_a: assembly, statutes or important notice → "Association communications";
p7.s2: Export the list right before sending. Never reuse an earlier export or a list saved in Gmail: it would still include people who left, or who switched the newsletter off.
p7.s3: Send from the association's account, with the addresses in BCC, never in To or CC. Otherwise every member sees everyone else's e-mail, which is a data breach. A Google Group whose members cannot see each other is an alternative.
p7.s4: In a newsletter, end with: "To stop receiving the newsletter, switch it off in My area › Communications."
p7.s5: Delete the exported file once the message has been sent.

badges.none_active: There are no badges yet. Create one with “New badge”.
badges.load_error: The badges could not be loaded. Refresh the page.
badges.archived_intro: No member sees them. Members who held them get them back if they are restored.
badges.held_before: {count, plural, =0 {No member held it} one {# member held it} other {# members held it}}
badges.delete_hint: “Delete” is only for superadmins and for badges that have never been awarded.
badges.delete_blocked_awarded: This one has already been awarded: it can only be archived.
badges.how_award_text: From each member's file, or to several members at once from the badge page.
badges.how_archive_text: The badge disappears for everyone, including those who hold it. No data is lost: it can be restored.
badges.how_delete_text: Superadmins only, and only if it has never been awarded (to fix a badge created by mistake).
badges.how_notice: Every change is recorded in the Activity log with the name the badge had.
badges.archive_count_text: {count, plural, one {active member will stop seeing it on their profile.} other {active members will stop seeing it on their profile.}}
badges.archive_warning: It disappears for everyone, including those who hold it, and cannot be awarded or revoked while archived. The data is kept: if you restore it, each member gets it back with the original date.
badges.restore_text: {count, plural, =0 {It shows on members' profiles again. Nobody held it.} one {It shows on members' profiles again. The member who held it gets it back with the original date.} other {It shows on members' profiles again. The # members who held it get it back with the original date.}}
badges.delete_text: It is removed from the catalogue for good. The Activity log keeps the name it had.

create.title: New badge
create.key_hint: Suggested from the name. Lower case, digits and “_”. It cannot be changed later.
create.key_invalid: The key must start with a letter and have 3 to 48 characters: lower case, digits and “_”.
create.locked_label: Text when they do not have it yet
create.note: The icon, the other languages and the visibility are set on the badge page, which opens once it is created. It goes at the end of the list.
create.disabled: Fill in the name, the key and both texts to create it.

edit.archived_notice: This badge is archived: no member sees it and it cannot be edited, awarded or revoked. Restore it to work on it again.
edit.name_hint: Up to 60 characters. No ID numbers or phone numbers: the name is kept in the Activity log.
edit.locked_label: Text when they do not have it yet
edit.fallback_hint: Catalan is required. If Spanish or English is missing, members see the Catalan text.
edit.switch_label: Show it locked to members who do not have it
edit.switch_hint: When off, the badge is “secret”: members do not see it until they receive it.
edit.order_hint: Members see them from lowest to highest.
edit.ca_required: The name and both texts in Catalan are required.
edit.order_invalid: The order must be a whole number.

preview.title: How members see it
preview.hidden: Members who do not have it do not see it: it is secret.
preview.hint: The preview follows the language tab of the texts.

holder_list.title: Members who have it
holder_list.summary: {count, plural, one {# active member} other {# active members}}
holder_list.none: No active member has it yet.
holder_list.load_error: The members who have it could not be loaded. Refresh the page.
holder_list.revoke_text: {name} ({number}) will no longer have this badge.
holder_list.reason_help: It is kept in the activity log. Do not write ID numbers or phone numbers.

award.title: Award to members
award.no_results: No active member matches the search.
award.search_error: The search failed. Please try again.
award.selected: {count, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}} · up to {max}
award.note_hint: Kept as the reason in the Activity log, once per member. Do not write ID numbers or phone numbers.
award.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Award} one {Award to # member} other {Award to # members}}
award.done: {count, plural, =0 {Not awarded to any new member} one {Awarded to # member} other {Awarded to # members}}
award.skipped: {count, plural, one {# already had it} other {# already had it}}

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again and try once more.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.not_found: The badge was not found. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_badge: This badge does not exist or is archived. Reload the page.
errors.badge_exists: There is already a badge with this key. Choose another one.
errors.badge_in_use: This badge has already been awarded: it can only be archived.
errors.badge_text_sensitive: The texts cannot contain an ID number or a phone number.
errors.badge_archived: This badge is archived. Reload the page.
errors.badge_held: This member already has this badge. Reload the page.
errors.badge_not_held: This member no longer has this badge. Reload the page.
errors.not_active: A member is no longer active: nobody was awarded. Reload and try again.
errors.no_value: There are no changes to save.
errors.reason_too_long: The text is too long (500 characters at most).
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
